issues.failure_explanation: If h=delta^mu, then y_j^delta=jh+h=y_{j+1}, so the P-piece on I^j is identically (j+1)h; if delta^mu>h, the P-piece decreases. Thus the lemma's strict monotonicity claim is false without the strict condition h>delta^mu, and the paper later chooses mu with h=delta^mu.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen the hypothesis to h>delta^mu in Shape-Lemma0, Inner-Lemma, the algorithm input, and the numerical parameter choice; keep mu<log_delta h in the tests.
issues.overall_effect: The advertised strictly increasing C^2 inner functions and the claim that psi_q' vanishes only at block endpoints fail at the equality case; derivative and monotonicity statements for psi_q become unreliable there.
issues.title: Strict monotonicity fails when h=delta^mu is allowed
issues.why_classification: The fix is a local strict-inequality hypothesis and a nearby numerical parameter change; the construction, smoothness, and convergence scope otherwise survive.
